scenario: `X then Y within T` is a fact-relative ordering window -- `Y.ts > X.ts` and `Y.ts - X.ts < T` (RLOW.5.6.1) -- decided by the facts with no clock, so it is not time-dependent and [LTIM.2.6.2] does not refuse it on a two-pattern rule. `compile_ok`. PATH: dsc.validate's ltim_2_6_2_clock_where, whose pattern-`within` arm counts a simple positive pattern's window and not a sequence step's; counting the step's window refuses this rule. The twin of LTIM.2.6.2_pattern_within_multipattern_rejects.
rules_ds:
schema A scope ttl 1_h:
    v: Int
    ts: Time

schema B scope ttl 1_h:
    v: Int
    ts: Time

rule seq:
    A a
    then B b within 5_s
->
    log info "{a.v} {b.v}"
